text:
```yaml
name: Trigger All Workflows

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  trigger-all:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Trigger all service workflows
        run: |
          for workflow in $(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/cokelaer/bioservices/actions/workflows | jq -r '.workflows[].path'); do
            if [[ $workflow != *"all.yml"* ]]; then
              echo "::set-output name=workflow::$workflow"
            fi
          done | xargs -I {} -P 10 curl -X POST -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" -d '{"event_type": "workflow_dispatch"}' https://api.github.com/repos/cokelaer/bioservices/dispatches

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write
  pull_request: write
  issues: write
  deployments: write
  pages: write
  workflows: write
  discussions: write
  repository_projects: write
  security_events: write
  statuses: write
  organization_administration: write
  team_discussions: write
  user_profile: write
  admin: false
```
